description:
Consume units of a consumable a wallet holds (the user spent a credit). Atomic: fails without change when the wallet holds fewer. Store key scope: entitlements:write.

Params: store_id, wallet, sku, quantity, session_token?, idempotency_key?
Returns: {ok, idempotency_key, entitlement: Entitlement}
Errors: INSUFFICIENT_QUANTITY (409), NO_CREDENTIALS, IAP_PLAN_REQUIRED, HTTP_404

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency-Key for this write. Omit to generate one; reuse the returned idempotency_key to retry safely

session_token.description: Session token from authenticate. Optional when CHAINDADDY_API_KEY is set (or, for store-scoped tools, CHAINDADDY_IAP_KEY)

name: iap_consume
title: Consume items
